title: Progress Bar Component
description: Abstract progress bar. Feed it value/max directly, or an items array with a declarative completed predicate — what the numbers mean (moves, stops, hours…) is the module's business. Renders nothing when max is 0, so it can be declared unconditionally.

name.description: Unique name identifier for the progress bar

value.description: Completed amount. Overrides the derived count when items/completedPath are also set

max.description: Total amount. Defaults to items.length when items is set. max 0 or missing → nothing renders

items.description: Single-chunk template resolving to an array, e.g. '{{ row.items }}'. Sets max = length; combined with completedPath sets value = matched count

completedPath.description: Dot path inside each item to test, e.g. orderMove.orderMoveStatus.statusStage

completedValue.description: Value at completedPath that counts as completed, e.g. Completed. Omitted → any truthy value counts

label.description: Caption on the left above the bar, e.g. Moves

showValue.description: Show the value caption (right-aligned for linear, centered for circular). Default true

height.description: Linear bar thickness in px. Default 6

size.description: Circular variant diameter in px. Default 40

color.description: Theme color (primary, success, warning, info, error, secondary) or CSS color. Default: primary, flipping to success at 100%
